Markets.title: CAS chaos triggers liquidity spiral: Nuvama says higher participation needed to break cycle
Markets.summary: BSE's new Closing Auction Session has suffered from low participation, causing sharp drops in option premium volumes and contracts. According to Nuvama, this thin liquidity has created a self-reinforcing liquidity spiral that requires higher participation to break.

Markets.title: Mom's Belief operator to launch IPO on Sep 1
Markets.summary: Rays of Belief Ltd, operator of Mom's Belief, will launch an initial public offering on September 1. The company will use the IPO proceeds to fund its expansion, which includes opening 319 new neurodevelopmental care centers across India by fiscal year 2029.

Markets.title: Bitcoin surges 23% in 1 week to trade nearly $78K as liquidity hopes, ETF inflows boost crypto markets
Markets.summary: Bitcoin jumped nearly 23% in a week to reach approximately $78,000 alongside rallies in Ethereum and major altcoins. The crypto market surge was driven by strong ETF inflows, lower Treasury yields, and reduced expectations of Federal Reserve tightening.

Markets.title: Bank stocks to buy: Goldman Sachs remains bullish on 6 private bank stocks. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Goldman Sachs expects Indian loan growth to moderate to 14–15% through fiscal year 2029 while initiating coverage on 14 lenders. The investment bank favors six private lenders: ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, Federal Bank, and AU Small Finance Bank.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty to consolidate further, says Sudeep Shah; picks 3 stocks for next week
Markets.summary: Analyst Sudeep Shah expects the Nifty to remain range-bound between 24,000 and 24,500 while warning of potential risks from underpriced options. He also highlights trading setups for AU Small Finance Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, and Nippon Life.

Markets.title: Vijay Kedia Portfolio: 5 stocks surge up to 55% in CY26; 1 new addition in June quarter
Markets.summary: Ace investor Vijay Kedia’s disclosed portfolio grew 21% to Rs 1,415 crore by August 2026, driven by gains of up to 53% in stocks like Neuland Laboratories. During the June quarter, he also added Eimco Elecon to his holdings, while other stocks like Innovators Facade Systems dropped 37%.

Geo-Political.title: Canada says it will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
Geo-Political.summary: Canada announced it will match upcoming United States tariffs dollar for dollar after trade negotiations failed. This retaliation comes in response to a new 50% American levy on $20 billion of Canadian imports.

Geo-Political.title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
Geo-Political.summary: TikTok and ByteDance agreed to pay a $400 million settlement to the United States. The settlement resolves a 2024 lawsuit accusing the companies of illegally collecting massive amounts of data from millions of children under 13.

Geo-Political.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
Geo-Political.summary: Thirty pioneer families have moved into a closed West Bank settlement in defiance of international protests and with the backing of the Israeli government. This rapid development has caused significant fear among nearby Palestinian residents.

Geo-Political.title: Rescuers dig through wreckage after 16 killed in Russian strike on Ukraine mall
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian strike on a Ukrainian shopping mall killed 16 people and injured 130 others, including children. Rescuers are searching the wreckage as nine people remain missing following the attack.

Geo-Political.title: One killed in sword attack at Swedish school
Geo-Political.summary: One person was killed and three others were injured in a sword attack at a Swedish school. An 18-year-old male suspect was shot and subsequently arrested by authorities.

Geo-Political.title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike, reports say
Geo-Political.summary: A Japanese man abandoned his tired seven-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue his hike with his older son. Police later rescued the boy unharmed, and authorities are investigating the father for potential child abandonment.

Data & Insights.title: India gets FDI approvals of  ₹4,896 cr under eased norms for land-border countries; not clear origin is from China
Data & Insights.summary: India has approved ₹4,896 crore in foreign direct investments under eased norms for land-border countries across sectors like IT, AI, and manufacturing. However, it remains unclear whether the origin of these investments is from China.

Data & Insights.title: India economic growth may beat RBI forecast: Deputy governor says 7% pace possible as indicators improve
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta stated that India's economic growth could surpass the central bank's 6.7% forecast and reach close to 7%. This improved outlook is driven by stronger-than-expected economic indicators, leading markets to increase bets on a later-year rate hike.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector growth likely picked up in August: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector growth likely accelerated in August, according to the HSBC Flash India PMI survey. This advance estimate provides an early indication of positive shifts in the country's economic sentiment and output.

Data & Insights.title: Consumers queue up for premium petrol as E20 concerns refuse to die down
Data & Insights.summary: Consumer concerns regarding the impact of ethanol-blended E20 petrol on vehicle engines have led to a surge in demand for premium, high-octane fuel. Consequently, sales of premium petrol have jumped from approximately 4% in March to a current share of 12% to 15%.

Data & Insights.title: India allows duty-free sugar imports as prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: India has eliminated its sugar import duty to reduce record-high domestic prices. This decision follows earlier government actions that banned sugar exports and tightened stock holding limits.

India.title: Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test Result 2026 Declared: Know How To Download Scorecard
India.summary: The Board of School Education Haryana has declared the HTET Result 2026. Candidates can now check the level-wise statistics and download their scorecards online.

India.title: Twist In Lucknow Double Murder-Suicide:  Cops Probe Rs 1 Crore Alimony Demand
India.summary: Police are investigating a double murder-suicide in Lucknow involving a couple who had been living separately for over a year. The probe focuses on the wife's reported demand for Rs 1 crore in alimony after she filed for divorce.

India.title: Indian Family Wipeout Over iPhone: The Dangerous Lure Of Consumer Tech Debt
India.summary: Young Indian consumers are purchasing expensive electronic devices like iPhones by using basic identity documents in physical retail stores. This trend often leaves families in severe financial distress when the cost of the device exceeds their total monthly income.

India.title: Centre Red-Flagged Revanth Reddy's US Visit Over Plans To Meet JD Vance, Zohran Mamdani
India.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs approved Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy's visit to the United Kingdom. However, the ministry rejected his proposed travel to the United States due to his plans to meet JD Vance and Zohran Mamdani.

India.title: China Outspends India In Space, But New Delhi Holds The Trust Card
India.summary: Although China spends more on space than India, an aerospace executive believes India is realistically positioned to capture third place globally. The United States currently remains the undisputed leader in the international space race.

India.title: 'Fertiliser Franchise', Rs 3.5 Crores Orders: Bihar Gang Arrested For Scam
India.summary: Bihar police arrested a gang for running a nationwide fertilizer franchise scam. The suspects are linked to 498 cybercrime complaints involving fraudulent transactions totaling approximately Rs 3.5 crore.

General.summary: Multiple people died at the scene of a car crash near Middlesbrough following a police pursuit. The police watchdog has opened an investigation into the collision.

General.title: Girl, 6, dies days after Shoreham sea tragedy killed three family members
General.summary: Six-year-old Saja El-Khawas has died following a water tragedy off the coast of West Sussex. She is the fourth member of her family to die after they got into difficulty in the sea near Shoreham.

General.summary: Due to soaring living costs, growing numbers of university students are choosing to live at home. Although students regret missing the traditional campus experience, they feel forced to make this decision out of financial necessity.
